answer: What survives to the garden is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the ridge of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the horizon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, slashed on a failed audit, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
